access_boundary: This record represents the Ling-3.0-flash BF16 weight release in the inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash repository, the base of the flash line. The Fin and VL continuations, the fp8, fp4, int4 and GGUF siblings, base and midtrain checkpoints, and any gateway-hosted free variant are separate boundaries.

Documented 124B total and 5.1B active parameter architecture with a 256K context schedule
tradeoffs: The MIT grant rests on model-card metadata with no LICENSE file in the repository
No first-party hosted API for the release was found in the sources read, and the card documents no release date
